title: Park View Room

services.name: Walking Tours
services.desc: The All America City program is Preservation Worcester’s premier education program. Designed to fit the Massachusetts third grade curriculum requirements for History and Social Science, the program uses the city’s architecture as a key to unlock students’ understanding of Worcester history. Enriching everyday history and social science classes with site-based learning, the program includes an initial, illustrated classroom presentation followed by a field trip. On the trip students experience Worcester’s architecture and built environment “first hand” with what they have learned about the city’s growth over time. Their visit to City Hall includes a role-playing session in the City Council
